item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council has approved the first reading of an ordinance to transfer 7 acres of city-owned land to the Florida Department of Transportation to support construction of a partial interchange on Florida's Turnpike at Midway Road. item.title: Lantana veteran gets lien removed and roof fixed after WPTV investigates contractor
item.description: Stephen McCoy, a disabled and retired veteran in Lantana, had a nearly $7,000 lien placed on his home after his roofing contractor allegedly failed to pay for materials.

item.title: Loggerhead Marinelife Center in Juno Beach offers sea turtle nesting season programs through September
item.description: The center is offering educational and interactive programs during peak sea turtle nesting season, including guided Turtle Walks, the Hatchling Discovery Program and Hatchling Releases.

item.title: Democratic first responder Bernard Taylor raises $563,000 in second quarter for Congressional District 21 race
item.description: Bernard Taylor, an EMT/paramedic challenging Republican U.S. Rep. Brian Mast, announced his campaign raised just under $563,000 in the second quarter with more than 25,000 individual donations averaging $22 each.

item.title: Woman dies after being pulled from burning home in Hobe Sound
item.description: A woman died after being pulled from a burning home in Hobe Sound on Thursday.

item.title: Two people rescued after boat sinks in Intracoastal Waterway
item.description: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office Marine Unit deputies rescued two boaters from the Intracoastal Waterway on Wednesday after their small motorized vessel sank.
